criteria.requirement: Extend FileUpload.save, static_file, BaseTemplate name/lookup and ResourceManager.add_path boundaries to accept str/bytes/os.PathLike via os.fspath/fsdecode, including custom PathLike and Unicode. Distinguish real paths from writable streams, support upload target directories and one directory lookup input, preserve caller stream ownership/cursor and existing file conflict/static containment rules. Invalid __fspath__ return types must fail instead of being stringified. Do not reinterpret template source text as filenames.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
